items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: He was the one who gave me my inspiration. ... He was my inspiration. I used to watch him and he was the one who got my inspiration to play.

ctx.x: He played in small comedy. He played in small comedy.
He was the only one I can remember. Can you tell us anything about Chiney?
You say when you used to hear him and you?
